description_en: Creates a custom disabled software entry
name: CreateProhibitedSoftware

parameters.help_en: The name of the disabled software
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the disabled software
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The IDs of custom disabled software tags to associate. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 待关联的自定义禁用软件标签ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: tag_ids

fields.help_en: The bundle ID of the application. This parameter is required only for macOS processes. You must specify at least one of BundleId and Process. Maximum length: 1024 characters
fields.help_zh: 应用包标识（Bundle ID），仅macOS进程需要填写。与Process至少填写一个。长度不超过1024个字符
fields.name: bundle_id

fields.help_en: The command line parameters for starting the process. If specified, only processes whose command line contains this content are matched. If left empty, the command line is not checked. Maximum length: 1024 characters
fields.help_zh: 进程启动命令行参数。填写后仅匹配命令行包含该内容的进程，留空则不校验命令行。长度不超过1024个字符
fields.name: cmdline

fields.help_en: The directory where the process is located. If specified, only processes with the same name in this directory are matched. If left empty, processes in any directory are matched. Maximum length: 1024 characters
fields.help_zh: 进程所在目录。填写后仅匹配该目录下的同名进程，留空则匹配任意目录。长度不超过1024个字符
fields.name: directory

fields.help_en: The process name. Maximum length: 1024 characters
fields.help_zh: 进程名称。长度不超过 1024 个字符
